## Source 1 — TikTok Shop's mandatory 2026 FBT (Fulfilled by TikTok) shift: $5/order penalty + Feb 9 deadline

**Type:** Industry news (Reddit r/TikTokshop + idcspy.com + yiofong.com — all republishing TikTok Shop merchant notices)
**Headline:** "TikTok Shop will require you to now use fulfilled by TikTok" / "TikTok Shop严控延迟发货!最高或按单5美元赔付"

### Verbatim excerpts:
> "Sellers onboarding on or after February 9, 2026 (PST) are required to fulfill all orders exclusively through TikTok Shop Logistics Services."
> "每个延迟发货订单,商家需向平台支付5美元损害赔偿金。要知道当前TikTok美区小店平均利润率仅8-15个点,很多低价单品的利润都不到5美元,一旦延迟,相当于'卖一单亏一单'。"
> "限流机制分级化:平台引入'延迟履约率(LDR)'红线,一旦超标直接限单:延迟率10%-20%,订单量限至此前日均的50%;20%-40%限至30%;40%-60%限至20%;60%以上直接砍至10%。"
> "TikTok Shop's sudden shipping mandate and rapid reversal left U.S. sellers scrambling. Here's what changed, what it means for your margins, and how to stay flexible."

### Pain points (verbatim audience language):
- "卖一单亏一单" (sell one order, lose money on it) — unit-economics collapse
- "流量本就是跨境卖家的生命线" (traffic IS the lifeblood) — funnel-throttling fear
- "sellers scrambling" — sudden mandate reversal created whiplash
- "exclusive through TikTok Shop Logistics Services" — losing 3PL flexibility
- "USPS labels to be printed through TikTok's platform" — losing last-mile routing control

### Why this works:
The textbook Pillar 1 angle — a specific dollar penalty ($5/order) that consumes an 8-15% margin, paired with tiered order-volume caps (10-60% of daily capacity). The Feb 9, 2026 FBT mandate is the new dimension: sellers lose the option to route through their own 3PLs. The math is the product: a 10K-order/month seller at 15% LDR loses $50K/month in penalties + 50% order volume cap + forced migration to TikTok Logistics = revenue + margin + flexibility hit. The narrative: "this is a math problem AND a control problem." **The verbatim "卖一单亏一单" line translates to a load-bearing post hook: "TikTok Shop will charge you $5 for every delayed order. If your margin is under $5, you sell a unit, you lose money. The penalty is now bigger than the profit. And starting Feb 9, you don't even get to choose your own 3PL."**
